Name: Faeries Horticulture - The Mixed Seeds Update
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/KauZcc5.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][left][/left][center]
﻿[size=4][b][color=#d5a6bd]Faeries Horticulture[/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4] is a fantasy-crop mod pack, that includes 16 different crops for you to plant on your farm.[/color]
[/size][size=4][color=#f4f4f4]These Crops are only available through the seasonal [/color][b][color=#f4cccc]Enchanted Mixed Seeds[/color][color=#e06666] [/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4]which can be traded for with somewhat rare items at Krobus. [/color]In order to have access to all Seeds, Ginger Island needs to be unlocked(!) 

[color=#f4f4f4]There's crops for every season including winter and most of the crops can be harvested multiple times.
[/color]

[color=#e06666]

Downloads.Description:
Download this version AND [CP] Faeries Horticulture Mixed Seeds in order to have access to the new Enchanted Season Seeds!

If you don't want to dpwnload both files, I reccommend using Better Seeds to have access to the Faeries Horticulture Crops.
